images.author: Mechi Torralva
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a plains zebra grazing in Kenya’s savanna; attractive green habitat. Original-resolution URL; dimensions and 9:10 crop not independently verified.

images.author: Charmain Jansen van Rensburg
images.why: Caption identifies a plains zebra standing in warm sunlight; source tags specify Equus quagga and Kruger National Park. Full-body framing and dimensions remain unverified.

images.author: Ivan Sabayuki
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies a wild plains zebra photographed on a game drive in Lake Mburo National Park, Uganda. Brown grassland setting; URL requests 3000px width.

images.author: Warwick Tarboton
images.why: Particularly close subject match: caption explicitly says plains zebra showing shadow stripes, photographed at Shingwedzi, Kruger. Sunlit golden grass; high-resolution originals require contacting the photographer.

images.author: Warwick Tarboton
images.why: Standing plains zebra in golden grass at Shingwedzi, Kruger. Species verified, but the caption specifically notes absent shadow stripes. Linked image dimensions are unverified.

images.author: Derek Keats
images.why: Photographer identifies Equus quagga at Pilanesberg National Park, South Africa. Commercially reusable with attribution; 1024px fallback, with larger original and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Pius Mahimbi
images.why: Strong geographic match: explicitly identified as Equus quagga in Ruaha National Park, Tanzania. 1024px fallback; full-body framing and higher-resolution availability unverified.

images.author: MonikaP
images.why: Source identifies two plains zebras in Lake Mburo National Park, Uganda. Original is listed as 4000 × 3000; this directly accessible version is 1280px, below the preferred resolution.

images.author: Viljami Väisänen
images.why: Domed Galápagos giant tortoise grazing amid vivid green vegetation, from the photographer’s Santa Cruz travel coverage. Filename indicates a 2048px export; actual dimensions were not independently checked.

images.author: Lloyd Douglas
images.why: Source identifies a Galápagos tortoise grazing in natural habitat and tags Santa Cruz Island. Listed at 3888 × 2592; green meadow and sunlight suit the brief, though framing is described as close-up.

images.author: Hugh Lansdown
images.why: Indexed source identifies Chelonoidis porteri eating fallen guava in Santa Cruz’s highlands. Distinctive feeding behaviour and lush vegetation; source access blocked final resolution and framing checks.

images.author: Tore (grebberg)
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies wild Chelonoidis porteri at Rancho El Chato, Santa Cruz, January 2017. Excellent provenance; 1024px fallback, with larger original and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Tore (grebberg)
images.why: Another independently captioned wild Chelonoidis porteri photograph from Rancho El Chato. Precise species and locality match; 1024px fallback, with full-body framing and larger sizes unverified.

images.author: Elias Rovielo
images.why: Source identifies Galápagos giant tortoises at El Chato Ranch, Santa Cruz, and describes the domed highland form. 1024px fallback; larger sizes unverified. Licence restricts commercial use.

images.author: Elias Rovielo
images.why: Alternative photograph from the same documented El Chato, Santa Cruz encounter. Correct Galápagos giant-tortoise group and habitat; 1024px fallback, with framing unverified. Commercial use requires permission.

images.author: David Stanley
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies domed Galápagos giant tortoises at El Chato Ranch, Santa Cruz. Freely licensed habitat alternative showing multiple animals; 1024px fallback, below the preferred resolution.
